items.toString:
As a Territory Manager or any user who has given access for New Submission, when I am setting up a new business submission (from NB-01), I need to add the products the broker has requested. This gives the Underwriter a starting point with the basic coverage information. The system should allow me to select products from UE's catalog and enter initial details like potential premium, current limits, and incumbent carrier.



|*#*|*Acceptance Criteria*|
|1|During submission creation (after saving NB-01), user is taken to the submission detail page where they can add products|
|2|User can access the Products section/tab to manage products for the submission|
|3|User can click "Add Product" to add a new product to the submission|
|4|System displays a product picker with products from UE's catalog|
|5|After selecting a product, user can enter basic product information|

LOB|Product|Coverage Mapping attached

*Basic Product Fields (during creation):*

||Field||Data Type||Required||
|Product|Picklist|Yes|
|Potential Premium|Currency|No|
|Current Limit|Text|No|
|Current SIR/Deductible|Text|No|
|Current Competitor Carrier|Text|No|

|#|Acceptance Criteria|
|6|When a product is added, system automatically associates all coverages for that product from UE_LOBs_Products_and_Coverages.xlsx|
|7|Coverages are for reference only during creation (read-only) and will be visible to the Underwriter during review|
|8|User can add multiple products to the same submission|
|9|User can edit or delete a product from the submission before it moves to Underwriting Review|
|10|System displays added products in a table with columns: Product, Quoted Premium (blank initially), Bound Premium (blank), Initial Rank, Final Rank, Actions|
|11|When a Product is added to a submission, the system automatically selects *all* Coverages associated with that Product in the master data (Reference: Product-to-Coverage Mapping).|
|12|The Underwriter has the ability to *deselect* (exclude) or *re-select* (include) individual Coverages for a Product.|
|13|If a Coverage is deselected, the system excludes it from the quote, premium calculation, and final policy documents (provided the underlying rating engine supports coverage-level removal).|
|14|If deselection of a Coverage violates a business rule (e.g., a "Core Coverage" cannot be removed, or a required endorsement is missing), the system displays a validation error and prevents saving until the rule is satisfied.|

items.toString:
*Navigation*: 

Homepage/Submissions

*Story:*

As an Underwriter or Business User, I want to view the Submissions list page with pipeline summary statistics so that I can quickly assess the overall health and volume of my underwriting pipeline at a glance.

*Fields & Behavior* 

|*Field*|*Section*|*Type*|*Behavior*|*Validation*|
|Total Submissions|Summary Bar|Read-only Count|Displays total count of all submissions|—|
|In Review|Summary Bar|Read-only Count|Displays count of submissions in Review stage|—|
|Quoted|Summary Bar|Read-only Count|Displays count of quoted submissions|—|
|Bound (YTD)|Summary Bar|Read-only Count|Displays year-to-date bound count|—|
|Bound Premium (YTD)|Summary Bar|Read-only Currency|Displays YTD bound premium in USD; highlighted in gold|—|
|Export|Header|Button|Downloads the current filtered submission list|—|
|+ New Submission|Header|Button|Navigates to New Submission form|—|

 

*Key Rules*

* Metrics are computed in real time from submission records
* Bound Premium (YTD) is displayed in gold/amber to distinguish monetary value
* All metric counts reflect the active tab and filter context

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Page displays header: 'Submissions' with subtitle 'Education insurance underwriting pipeline (TBD) · N total submissions'
* Summary bar shows Total Submissions, In Review, Quoted, Bound (YTD), and Bound Premium (YTD)
* Bound Premium is formatted as currency (e.g., $552,200)
* Export and + New Submission buttons are visible and accessible from the header
* Page loads with the 'All' tab active by default

*Dependencies:*  Live submission data from Workbench database
